chocolateDescription: Why load up on sugar and fats from chocolate when you’ve just burned it off in that spin class?
chikkiDescription: Chikki, made from jaggery and nuts, offers a natural sweetness with protein and minerals, keeping you satisfied without the sugar crash.
chipsDescription: Crunching on chips? That’s hundreds of empty calories! Your 15,000 steps shouldn’t just go towards fueling unhealthy cravings.
makhanaDescription: Makhana is low-calorie, rich in antioxidants, and provides a guilt-free crunch that actually benefits your health.
momosDescription: Ditch those deep-fried momos! You didn’t do those 20 squats just to munch on extra calories.
paniyaramDescription: Paniyaram is steamed and made from fermented batter, offering probiotics and less oil compared to fried momos.
pastriesDescription: You deserve a treat, but do you really want that sugary pastry to undo all your hard work at the gym?
ragiCakeDescription: Ragi cake is fiber-rich, with calcium and iron, making it a much healthier, less sugary dessert choice.
omeletteDescription: One omelette won’t undo the hour you spent on the treadmill, but is it giving you the nutrition you deserve?
moongDalCheelaDescription: Moong dal cheela is protein-packed, low-fat, and a great plant-based alternative that keeps you fuller for longer.
nachosDescription: Nachos and cheese? That’s 200 extra calories you’ll regret later! Why not treat your body to something that works with your efforts?
khakraDescription: Khakra is a roasted, whole grain snack that provides a crunchy and healthier alternative with less oil and more fiber.
subwayDescription: Subway may sound healthy, but with all that processed bread and sauces, you’re undoing all your fitness progress.
paneerRollDescription: Paneer rolls with whole wheat roti are a cleaner, fresher, and more balanced meal that provides protein without excess calories or additives.
maggiDescription: Is that quick Maggi fix really worth sabotaging your long-term health goals? Why let your 30-minute yoga session go to waste?
vermicelliUpmaDescription: Vermicelli upma is a lighter, less processed option, with added veggies that offer more fiber and nutrients.

north1.title: Moong Dal Cheela With Stuffed Paneer
north1.description: A healthy and protein-rich savory pancake made from ground moong dal batter, lightly spiced, and cooked to golden perfection. The cheela is stuffed with a flavorful paneer filling, making it a wholesome and delicious dish, often enjoyed with chutney or yogurt. Perfect for breakfast or a light meal!
comments: Great job, will definitely try this!

north2.title: Kabuli Chana Salad
north2.description: A nutritious and refreshing salad made with boiled chickpeas (Kabuli Chana), fresh vegetables, and zesty spices. It’s a perfect blend of crunch and flavor, ideal for a light snack or side dish.
comments: This salad is so refreshing and healthy! The spices add just the right kick to the chickpeas.
Tried it for lunch, and it was light yet filling. Perfect for summer days!

north3.title: Aloo Simla Mirch Ki Sabzi
north3.description: A simple yet flavorful dry curry made with potatoes and capsicum stir-fried in aromatic Indian spices. This dish pairs wonderfully with parathas or chapatis for a wholesome meal.
comments: A classic dish with minimal ingredients but packed with flavor. Loved it with parathas!
The capsicum adds a great crunch to the soft potatoes. Simple and delicious!
